reason: Provides a remote WebSocket connection between local DeepSeek Harness instances and a community website, enabling remote plugin installation, device status viewing, and cached registry browsing; its remote instruction execution and plugin build-script behavior warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 将本机 DeepSeek Harness 连接到社区网站，以便远程查看设备与插件注册表并在本机执行插件安装。
summaries.en: Connects a local DeepSeek Harness instance to a community website for remote device and plugin-registry viewing and local plugin installation.

capabilities: connects to a remote WebSocket service
persists a device token and device identifier locally
caches a remote plugin registry for offline browsing
